scope: QA-WIN-04 only: storage status and dynamic overlay copy; quit/script independently reviewed elsewhere

findings.title: Already-open ASK card retains ongoing-storage assertion after not_storing notification
findings.observed: stalled, stored=0, unknown=1, storing=false; main sends not_storing and control updates; open card still says are also being stored; freshly opened card is correct
findings.minimal_fix: Avoid present-tense service assertions in an immutable selection card, or update only visible status metadata on change while preserving selected pixels/ink/frame anchors.

findings.title: Queue exhaustion changes stalled to storing without an answered upload
findings.observed: All six batch attempts returned typed 503. After removal of a copied temp original, unknown job becomes stuck; none plan sets sending/storing=true with stored=0, unknown=2. Header says are also being stored.
findings.minimal_fix: Do not infer answered storage state from queue emptiness; retain unconfirmed status without preventing later valid work or losing the unknown job. Recovery may follow appropriate actual answered upload evidence.
